title: Chapter 375: The Birth Of A Monster
content:
Chapter 375: The Birth Of A Monster

Lu Xue's heart moved slightly and quickly turned around and looked into the deserted city.

I saw a nine-clawed divine dragon emitting dazzling golden light circling its huge body showing its might in the void above the deserted city.

A breath from ancient times poured out from the dragon's body.

At the same time, somewhere in the Chaos Realm.

In a hazy little world.

That is the ancestral land of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

At this moment, a faint breath suddenly came from the ancestral land that had been silent for endless years.

"Xiaoqing!"

Lu Xue waved to the dragon, her eyebrows curled.

That divine dragon is Ao Qing who has not seen for a long time.

When Ao Qing saw Lu Xue, he looked excited and suddenly came towards Lu Xue, almost burst into tears.

"My little master, wuwu, I miss you so much!"

Lu Xue stood in front of Ao Qing, as small as Ao Qing's scales, but at this moment, Lu Xue was like coaxing a child, stretching out her hand to caress Ao Qing's forehead.

"Okay, okay, you were in seclusion before, I didn't call you."

"My master, if I knew you would leave, I wouldn't go into seclusion no matter what I said."

At that time, Lu Xue had just left for a while, and Ao Qing came out of seclusion.

When he heard the news of Lu Xue's departure, his mood was like a bolt from the blue.

He just felt the sky collapsed.

How can he live without a little master?

Fortunately, I was brought here after only a few days.

Ao Qing came to his senses and turned around to look at this new world. The huge dragon's eyes flashed with light.

He smelled the good stuff.

"My master, let's go out for a walk."

Ao Qing turned his head and spoke to Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue rolled her eyes and said angrily: "Shopping? What are you doing? You have only your strength. You won't be caught and roasted when you go out."

Although Huangcheng was very eye-catching at this time, Huangcheng's strength was too weak compared to the current Chaos Realm.

Ao Qing's head, who was ruthlessly hit, suddenly drooped.

He had already begun to miss the days when his master was there.

At that time, how carefree, my cultivation was rising while I was lying down. When did I ever worry about my strength?

Looking at the moment, following the little master, I was worried all day long.

Alas, when will this hard day end?

Ao Qing's sighing look immediately attracted Lu Xue.

Lu Xue's pretty face was slightly cold, "What are you complaining about, you stupid dragon? Why don't you practice quickly if you have this time!"

It was clear just now, but now it was a strong wind.

Ao Qing didn't even speak, Lu Xue knew what Ao Qing was thinking.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Ao Qing quickly shrank his body and returned to Lu Xue's wrist again.

At this time, Lu Xue looked at her aunt again.

Jiang Xiaoxiao.

At this moment, there seemed to be an invisible magnetic field around Jiang Xiaoxiao, separating Jiang Xiaoxiao from the Chaos Realm.

It is very similar to An Changzai and the other three, but it is different.

It’s obvious that my aunt’s strength is probably very terrifying.

Tsk tsk, I suddenly became so smooth that I couldn't adapt.

However, as soon as Lu Xue's mouth rose, a terrifying wave suddenly came from the corner of the Chaos Realm, and then instantly attacked the entire Chaos Realm.

Rumble!

All living beings were startled.

Immediately afterwards, a disgusting aura came to my face.

Countless weak creatures felt that this aura was full of vomiting and diarrhea, and they were all unconscious.

Although stronger beings can still remain awake, their bodies are very weak.

What is amazing is the human race.

The entire human race was not affected at all.

Everyone looked up and saw that the huge deserted city was emitting a peaceful aura, protecting the entire human race.

It is really the most treasure of heaven and earth!

"What is that?"

Lu Xue frowned, and she felt an extremely ominous feeling.

Sure enough, how could things be smooth sailing?

My father left her three strong men to help her deal with the major powerful tribes in the Chaos Realm, and then left.

Later, he sent his aunt to Huangcheng to help him.

In this case, this sudden change is likely to be arranged by my father.

Haha, Dad, you still like to exercise me so much.

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao spoke, "That seems to be a powerful creature awakening, very evil, and,

Jiang Xiaoxiao paused, her tone slightly heavier.

"He seems to be growing continuously, at an extremely fast speed. If he lets him develop, the entire Chaos Realm will suffer."

As soon as these words came out, everyone present was shocked.

"What!"

A growing monster.

If these words were spoken by others, they might be a little surprised.

But this was said by the mysterious powerful man from the heavenly world, the aunt of the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace.

Then how strong this monster must be.

Everyone's expressions gradually became solemn, and they unconsciously looked at Lu Xue.

At this moment, Lu Xue was already the backbone of the entire human race.

"Hao Lord, what should I do now?"

An Chang looked at Lu Xue with a respectful look.

Next, no matter what decision Lu Xue makes, they will follow it.

Lu Xue pondered for a moment, then looked at Jiang Xiaoxiao, "Aunt, how about that monster, how about you?"

Hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao showed a faint smile on her face.

"At least, he is not my opponent yet."

Huh ~

Lu Xue breathed a sigh of relief and no longer hesitated.

"Continue to keep a close eye on the Three Gods. If you have any movement, you can do it directly."

"Aunt, take me to see."

After saying that, Lu Xue looked at her mother again.

Yan Lingyun smiled softly, "Be careful, this time, my mother can't help much."

Lu Xue nodded, "Mom, I'm grown up now, don't worry."

Looking at Lu Xue in front of her, Yan Lingyun was in a daze for a moment.

She seemed to see an illusory figure.

That was exactly what I was when I was young.

Time flies so fast.

When Yan Lingyun came to her senses, Jiang Xiaoxiao had already taken Lu Xue toward the border of the Chaos Realm.

In place, Yan Lingyun remained silent for a long time, and finally shook her head and walked towards the deserted city.

At the same time, the deserted city has also begun to open to the public.

However, only human races are allowed to enter.

Moreover, no force is allowed to be used when entering the deserted city.

Of course, they couldn't do it even if they wanted to use it. After all, the power of the laws in the deserted city was arranged by Lu Daosheng himself.

On the other side, in the small world of the God Clan.

The three gods are huddled together at this moment, and are also discussing what.

"What do you think about this?"

It was still the first leader of the Heavenly God clan to speak.

Now he is no longer as broken as he was at the beginning.

Things seem to have turned around.

"It seems that God has not given up on us."

The leader of the God Blood Clan spoke calmly, with a meaningful smile on his lips.

As soon as these words were spoken, both patriarchs were slightly stunned.

Now they have no evidence to prove that it is God's help to them.

But after calming down, they reacted.

God, I have not given up on them!
